124 MX [dep019.runtime-image,sec001.no-secrets,x.dk-compose-actual-infra,x.dk-probes,wf019.dp-prod-migrations,x.dk-image-variants,x.dk-principles] ;; Common-mistakes list restating rule-owned items and the container guidance registered above.

C dep019.dk-no-build-tooling OL DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Keep build tooling out of production runtime images. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-principles EX DEP-018,SEC-002 DEFAULT ;; Keep configuration external (environment-specific values passed at runtime), images reproducible and Docker concerns out of the application architecture; prefer the deployment platform's health-probe capabilities. ;; = ;; none ;; Container design principles not in the oracle.
C x.dk-copy-explicit EX DEP-023 MUST ;; Copy only the repository-level build files that exist and restore needs, and copy project files explicitly (no wildcard tricks that flatten the multi-project structure). ;; = ;; none ;; Dockerfile copy rule not in the oracle.
C dep019.dk-worker-runtime OL DEP-019 DEFAULT ;; Use the .NET runtime image (not aspnet) for workers that do not need ASP.NET Core. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-restore-caching EX - DEFAULT ;; Copy project and build files before the full source to keep the restore layer cached; update the project-copy section when the solution structure changes; a correct restore graph matters more than caching. ;; delivery ;; none ;; Restore-layer technique not in the oracle.
C dep019.dk-non-root OL DEP-019 MUST ;; Use the built-in non-root user, give written directories proper ownership/permissions and understand a permission problem before reaching for root. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec001.dk-no-baked-secrets OL SEC-001,SEC-002 MUST_NOT ;; Real credentials stay out of Dockerfiles, committed Compose files, build arguments visible in image metadata and copied appsettings files; use platform/container secret mechanisms. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-compose-actual-infra EX GOV-013,DEP-018 MUST ;; Add only the Compose infrastructure the project actually uses, not PostgreSQL, Redis or RabbitMQ because they appear in examples. ;; = ;; none ;; Compose-scope rule not in the oracle.
C sec001.dk-local-passwords OL SEC-001,SEC-002 MUST ;; Keep local passwords in an ignored .env or similar developer configuration. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dk-probes EX API-019 DEFAULT ;; Expose liveness/readiness through ASP.NET Core health checks and prefer the orchestrator's native HTTP probes; if Compose runs an in-container health command verify the executable exists or add a deliberate probe mechanism, weighing debugging packages in production images. ;; = ;; none ;; Probe technique not in the oracle.
C x.dk-angular-static EX DEP-018 DEFAULT ;; Build static Angular in a Node stage and serve assets with the chosen hosting strategy (Nginx not mandatory); keep API base URLs and environment configuration compatible with that strategy. ;; = ;; none ;; Angular container guidance not in the oracle.
C x.dk-dockerignore EX - MUST ;; Keep files required by restore/build in the build context, and tests when the image build intentionally runs them. ;; delivery ;; none ;; .dockerignore rule not in the oracle.
C x.dk-image-variants EX RUN-008,GOV-013 DEFAULT ;; Start from standard supported .NET images; Alpine, chiseled, trimming or Native AOT only when compatibility and deployment requirements justify them, verifying globalization, native dependencies, reflection and diagnostics. ;; = ;; none ;; Image-variant guidance not in the oracle.
C x.dk-verify EX WF-006,SEC-001 MUST ;; Build the image; verify startup, port and configuration, non-root behaviour and health-probe integration; review the image for accidental secrets or files; run meaningful tests outside the image or in the pipeline. ;; = ;; none ;; Container verification checklist not in the oracle.

179 NN ;; Heading.
181-182 NN ;; Table header.
183-192 DU [tst002.narrowest-level,tst006.waf,tst007.provider-fidelity,run004.timeprovider,tst009.dt-regression,tst010.dt-probes,x.dt-smoke-definition,tst004.dt-external-fakes] ;; Decision guide mapping scenarios to the rules and guidance captured above.

C x.dt-proportional-infra EX GOV-012,TST-011 DEFAULT ;; Test the risks that matter and build test infrastructure only for a concrete testing need; a small project does not need an enterprise harness. ;; = ;; none ;; Test-infrastructure proportionality not in the oracle.
C tst005.dt-readable-cases OL TST-005,TST-003 DEFAULT ;; Optimize tests for clarity; enumerate small finite cases with [TestCase] rather than loops, LINQ, TestCaseSource or derived expectations; state expected results instead of computing them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst005.dt-explicit-table OL TST-005 DEFAULT ;; A longer explicit table beats a shorter algorithmic test when it makes business rules visible. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-one-scenario EX TST-003 PREFER ;; Prefer one observable scenario per test; multi-step tests when the sequence itself is the scenario. ;; = ;; none ;; Scenario-granularity guidance not in the oracle.
C x.dt-unit-candidates EX TST-002,TST-003 DEFAULT ;; Unit-test candidates: domain behaviour owned by Domain, calculations, state transitions, validation, Application orchestration with simple fakes; mock architectural boundaries when it clarifies, never every collaborator mechanically, and do not forbid mocking project-owned abstractions. ;; = ;; none ;; Mocking guidance not in the oracle.
C tst003.dt-app-service-tests OL TST-003,TST-002,TST-006 DEFAULT ;; Application service tests use controlled doubles and assert results and meaningful side effects; call-count assertions only when the interaction is the contract; integration tests when EF, transactions, DI, serialization or HTTP matter. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst004.dt-testing-env OL TST-004 MUST ;; Configure the Testing environment with isolated test resources so integration tests cannot reach a development or production database by accident. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst007.dt-provider-fidelity OL TST-007 DEFAULT ;; Use the actual provider when provider fidelity matters (Testcontainers a good option); EF Core InMemory is not a relational substitute. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-state-tradeoff EX TST-007 MUST ;; When provider fidelity does not matter a lighter isolated relational database may be used, stating the trade-off. ;; = ;; none ;; Trade-off statement not in the oracle.
C tst008.dt-known-state OL TST-008,TST-004 MUST ;; Start from a known state (recreate/reset the isolated database, transactions when they fit, only needed data, unique identifiers). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-persistence-tests EX TST-002 DEFAULT ;; Test repository implementations or EF mappings when there is meaningful persistence behaviour (custom mappings, filters, projections, non-trivial queries, relationships, concurrency, provider behaviour). ;; = ;; none ;; Persistence-test targeting not in the oracle.
C tst011.dt-no-trivial OL TST-011 MUST_NOT ;; One test per trivial Add/Get method adds coverage numbers, not value. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst004.dt-external-fakes OL TST-004 MUST ;; At external boundaries use fakes/mocks, stub HttpMessageHandler or local fake servers; a dedicated sandbox only when the test explicitly targets that integration. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-slow-separate EX TST-004 DEFAULT ;; Keep slow or unreliable external-system tests separate from ordinary fast runs. ;; = ;; none ;; Test-separation guidance not in the oracle.
C x.dt-test-data EX TST-008,GOV-012 DEFAULT ;; Keep test data explicit and minimal; builders/fixtures only when repeated setup becomes hard to read; no generic test-data framework for a few objects. ;; = ;; none ;; Test-data guidance not in the oracle.
C tst009.dt-regression OL TST-009 DEFINITION ;; A regression test reproduces the failure before the fix and passes after it; it adds nothing for problems that cannot realistically recur or are covered. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst010.dt-probes OL TST-010 MUST ;; Temporary probes (HTTP requests, scripts, ad-hoc tests, manual DB checks) become maintained tests (e.g. NUnit WebApplicationFactory tests) or confirmed existing coverage that really exercises the behaviour; review probes before keeping them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-smoke-definition EX WF-006 DEFINITION ;; A smoke test is a small set of fast checks that a built or deployed application is basically operational, not every integration test. ;; = ;; none ;; Definition not in the oracle.
C tst011.dt-coverage OL TST-011 MUST_NOT ;; Coverage is diagnostic information, not a target; prioritize meaningful behaviour, edge cases and risky integrations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dt-snapshots EX TST-003,DEP-001 DEFAULT ;; Snapshot testing only for large stable outputs; small or important contracts use explicit assertions; a snapshot library is not added by default. ;; = ;; none ;; Snapshot guidance not in the oracle.
C x.dt-no-assertion-free EX TST-003 AVOID ;; Avoid assertion-free tests unless the behaviour is 'does not throw'. ;; = ;; none ;; No owner clause for this item.

350 NN ;; Heading.

354-365 DU [x.ef-tracking,run006.ef-project,run006.ef-no-lazy,x.ef-bulk-ops,run008.ef-compiled-queries,arc018.ef-transactions,pst010.dw-migration-review,wf019.dp-prod-migrations,pst001.seed-default,pst006.leave-existing,tst008.known-state] ;; Decision guide mapping scenarios to the rules and guidance captured above.

C arc016.ef-uow-delegates OL ARC-016,ARC-017 DEFINITION ;; IUnitOfWork is the Application-facing commit-boundary abstraction; its Infrastructure implementation delegates to the same scoped DbContext the repositories use. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-entity-config EX ARC-019 DEFAULT ;; Keep entity configuration in IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> classes. ;; = ;; none ;; Configuration-class convention not in the oracle.
C arc002.ef-config-out-of-domain OL ARC-002 DEFAULT ;; Keep persistence-specific configuration out of Domain entities where practical. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc023.ef-registration OL ARC-023,DEP-009 MUST ;; Register EF Core and persistence implementations in Infrastructure with the provider the project actually uses, not one from an example. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc015.ef-base-class OL ARC-015,ARC-019 ALLOWED ;; An Infrastructure-only base class may remove genuine duplication while concrete repositories keep the full EF Core API. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run006.ef-project OL RUN-006 DEFAULT ;; Project in the database for read-only queries needing selected data; projection is not mandatory when the use case needs the entity, but avoid loading a whole aggregate for a few fields. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-tracking EX RUN-006 DEFAULT ;; Use tracking queries when loaded entities will be modified and committed through the current Unit of Work and AsNoTracking() for read-only entity queries where tracking adds nothing; projections need no AsNoTracking(). ;; = ;; none ;; Tracking technique not in the oracle.
C x.ef-query-shape EX RUN-006 DEFAULT ;; Make the query shape explicit (projection for selected related data, Include/ThenInclude when the graph is required); for large collection includes consider split queries and check SQL and performance. ;; = ;; none ;; Query-shape guidance not in the oracle.
C run006.ef-no-lazy OL RUN-006 AVOID ;; Avoid lazy loading by default; it hides database access and invites N+1 queries. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run006.ef-paginate OL RUN-006 DEFAULT ;; Filter, order and paginate in the database. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-deterministic-order EX RUN-006 MUST ;; Pagination uses deterministic ordering. ;; = ;; none ;; Ordering requirement not in the oracle.
C x.ef-bulk-ops EX ARC-016,ARC-019 MUST_NOT ;; ExecuteUpdateAsync/ExecuteDeleteAsync bypass change tracking: do not mix them casually with tracked entities for the same rows and understand their transaction and consistency implications. ;; = ;; none ;; Bulk-operation rule not in the oracle.
C arc018.ef-transactions OL ARC-018,ARC-016 DEFAULT ;; One SaveChangesAsync is the transaction boundary of an operation; an explicit transaction fits a concrete case where several operations or SaveChangesAsync calls succeed or fail together; EF transactions do not solve distributed transactions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.ef-compiled-queries OL RUN-008 DEFAULT ;; Normal LINQ is the default; compiled queries belong to measured hot paths where profiling shows compilation/cache-lookup overhead matters, not queries that merely run often. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-interceptors EX ARC-019,FE-008 MUST_NOT ;; EF Core interceptors fit infrastructure-level cross-cutting behaviour with a clear benefit (e.g. auditing); business behaviour does not belong in them. ;; = ;; none ;; EF interceptor rule not in the oracle.
C pst006.ef-anchor-detect OL PST-006,PST-005 MUST ;; Detect existing data with representative root/anchor entities; the seeder assumes the schema is already migrated; developers apply migrations first, then startup seeds the empty schema. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst003.ef-startup OL PST-003,PST-005,PST-004 MUST ;; At startup the internal seeder stays behind the narrow Infrastructure extension, runs in Development only, and migrations are not run there. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst001.ef-states OL PST-001,PST-007 DEFAULT ;; Cover representative states where applicable (new, active, completed, archived, optional values/relationships, status values, boundary states) without attempting every combination; entities follow the current model. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-ask-dataset EX GOV-003,PST-001 MUST ;; When the required entity graph or scenarios are complex, ask for the desired dataset in the task requirements instead of inventing a large generic object graph. ;; = ;; none ;; Dataset-request rule not in the oracle.
C pst006.ef-recreate OL PST-006 MUST ;; A developer who needs the latest seed dataset drops and recreates the local database explicitly. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-migration-projects EX ARC-019 DEFAULT ;; Create migrations from the Infrastructure project with the API project as startup project. ;; = ;; none ;; Migration-project convention not in the oracle.
C wf019.ef-scripts OL WF-019 PREFER ;; For controlled production deployment generated migration scripts are often preferable. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run001.ef-query-perf OL RUN-001,RUN-012,RUN-006 DEFAULT ;; Start with clear LINQ and optimize after identifying a real problem, inspecting round trips, columns, N+1, indexes, SQL, plans, materialized data and tracking overhead. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.ef-raw-sql OL RUN-008 DEFAULT ;; Raw SQL fits queries EF Core cannot express effectively or a measured performance need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec004.ef-parameterized OL SEC-004 PREFER ;; Prefer APIs that keep parameterization (FromSql, FromSqlInterpolated, ExecuteSql) over building SQL strings. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-fire-and-forget EX RUN-002 AVOID ;; Avoid fire-and-forget EF Core asynchronous operations. ;; = ;; none ;; No owner clause for this item.
